description: CPU cost of FACT under a realistic agent workload: the E7r replays (the recorded tool calls of four or eight LLM agents, at their recorded timing, through the shared MCP server with the per-execution policy) with COST=1: CPU of the collector and of the policy loader, run time of every eBPF program (bpf_stats), host CPU, and factd's CPU on the same stream (scripts/cost_probe.py). Attribution and policy outcomes are scored as in E7r.
